memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports mild stiffness in hands after morning chores, able to walk to bus stop unaided. cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal) – negative screen. falls: no falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds – normal. medicines: 6 regular (methotrexate, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, prednisolone, timolol, latanoprost) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised. mood: denies low mood or anxiety; enjoys time with grandchildren. carers: daughter Priya, provides occasional transport. goals: "I want to keep driving the school bus and stay independent."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 22 mm/hr (0-20) slightly ↑; CRP 6 mg/L (0-5) ↑; rheumatoid factor 48 IU/ml (<14) ↑; anti-CCP 68 U/ml (<20) ↑; LFT: ALT 32 U/L (7-56), AST 28 U/L (10-40), ALP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 35 U/L (0-51), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2-1.2) – all within normal.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate 10 mg oral once weekly; folic acid 5 mg oral once weekly; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily; prednisolone 5 mg oral daily; timolol 0.5% eye drops one drop both eyes twice daily; latanoprost 0.005% eye drops one drop both eyes at bedtime.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: eye exam: intraocular pressure right eye 18 mmHg (10-21), left eye 19 mmHg (10-21); optic disc assessment shows mild cupping (CDR 0.4) stable; no retinal changes. Visual field not performed today.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 18 mm/hr (0-20) normal; CRP 4 mg/L (0-5) normal; LFT: ALT 30 U/L, AST 26 U/L, ALP 80 U/L, GGT 33 U/L, bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL – all within normal.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: hand stiffness improved, able to grip bus steering wheel without pain; walks to market unaided. cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual screen due). falls: no falls; gait smooth; timed up-and-go 9 seconds – normal. medicines: 6 regular – polypharmacy, Beers review pending. mood: reports occasional worry about eye drops but overall cheerful. carers: daughter Priya assists with medication box. goals: "I wish to keep my vision clear for driving."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate increased to 15 mg oral once weekly; folic acid 5 mg oral once weekly unchanged; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily unchanged; prednisolone tapered to 2.5 mg oral daily; timolol 0.5% eye drops unchanged; latanoprost 0.005% eye drops unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 30 mm/hr (0-20) ↑; CRP 9 mg/L (0-5) ↑; rheumatoid factor 55 IU/ml (<14) ↑; anti-CCP 72 U/ml (<20) ↑; LFT: ALT 38 U/L, AST 32 U/L, ALP 85 U/L, GGT 40 U/L, bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL – mild transaminitis, monitor.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: increased hand pain and swelling after methotrexate dose rise, reports difficulty fastening bus seatbelt; walks with mild limp after long walks. cognition: Mini-Cog not due. falls: one fall at home while reaching for shelf 2 months ago, no injury; gait slightly antalgic; timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk, advise strength exercises and supportive footwear. medicines: 6 regular – polypharmacy, Beers review ordered. mood: frustrated about pain, denies depression. carers: son Arjun helps with grocery shopping. goals: "I want to reduce joint pain so I can work without fear."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: visual field test: right eye shows mild paracentral scotoma, left eye within normal limits; consistent with early glaucomatous change. IOP measured at 20 mmHg OD, 19 mmHg OS.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed my vision feels a bit dimmer in the mornings, especially when reading the bus schedule. Eye drops sometimes sting.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to glaucoma specialist Dr. S. Rao at Narayana Nethralaya for optic disc assessment and consideration of topical therapy adjustment. Include recent visual field and IOP results.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Specialist report: optic disc CDR 0.5 OD, 0.45 OS; visual field stable; recommends continuing timolol BD and latanoprost HS, add brimonidine 0.1% OD at night. No surgical intervention needed. Return to routine glaucoma monitoring in 4 months.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-11-02 09:30 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for routine geriatric review. Patient to bring medication list and recent eye drop diary.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: hand pain improved after methotrexate dose adjustment and physiotherapy; able to drive bus route without discomfort. cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw mild deficit) – negative screen (annual). falls: no falls in past 6 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 10 seconds – normal. medicines: 6 regular – polypharmacy, Beers review completed, no inappropriate meds. mood: reports good spirits, enjoys gardening. carers: daughter Priya reminds about eye drops. goals: "I want to stay active and see my grandchildren grow."
